question: What Is The Meaning Of Life?

answers.text: Yeah, I'm working on that.
How to reduce suffering in other people
Connection Togetherness, community Living for each other and doing well by each other. Doing right
To be happy
Like they say, pursuit of happiness, etc..
Just keep going forward, I guess. Don't let anything stop you. That's like the meaning of life for me
It’s to love We’re supposed to love you know? Everybody's supposed to show love. If everybody do that, everybody would be, you know, surprised and happy, you know.
You know, when you find out, let me know.
Take it easy. Don't sweat the little things. We've been here before. Listen to your ancestors Ask your ancestors how they got through things.
To be happy and to bring happiness to other people.
Be happy every day you wake up and get out of bed and, have a goal you want to achieve every day.
Make an impact on the world, on your community.
The meaning of life is to be with your people. Be with your friends. Be with your family. Make the most of your time with them.
Love.
Benefit others in someway. Leave the world better than you got there.
Do better.
Do better. Help others. That's all I got.
I had no idea.
I kind of feel like the meaning is to keep questioning everything and not really expecting to get any answers.

I mean, finding purpose. But now I've just moved to New York, so it's like I realized that great part of my purpose is surrounded by friends. And I'm missing a lot of my friends back home. So, I don't know, I'm still, like, understanding, the meaning of life.
I think the meaning of life varies for each person. For me, it's about enjoying where I am and balancing between living in the present, but also being mindful of the future too
be happy.
You define your own meaning It could be friends, It could be family. It could be passions. It could be work. Just, you know, just follow whatever you feel

It think it’s for everyone to decide. But for me, it's being with the people I care about. Trying to leave a positive impact on the world. Trying to think about things in a bigger way and try to make some mark on this world
I don't know. Go out and have a good time.
Life's meaning is emergent through our activity It's not defined for us ahead of time. We find it through our through our struggle and through being on the planet.
